preparation.description: Prepared Spesolimab–IL-36R complex from 6U6U. Editable VH positions 97–108; native light chain, framework and HCDR1/2 remain fixed.

tools.name: Saved H/L/antigen structure and declared edit mask
Three sequences selected in descending reported score order

outputs.recorded_result: Fixed panel; lower NLL is preferred

outcome.summary: Three recorded sequence pairs were evaluated in run_005. The selection used descending AntiBMPNN score, while the tool score is a negative log likelihood for which lower is preferred. Historical panel identifiers are retained; they do not indicate best-likelihood sequences.

evidence.usage_basis: session-scoped approximate attribution: chat-level totals for the 2026-11-16 GLM session split evenly across the five task_015 runs; marked ~ because per-run token metering is not exposed by the runtime
evidence.standard_table_provenance: Standard candidate/sequence/metric views were transcribed from preserved native CSV/JSON outputs during package arrangement. Reassembled IgDesign variable domains use only the saved native framework and declared CDR placements. No generation, model prediction, ranking policy or measured endpoint was rerun. Generation-run shortlists point to the existing evaluation run; they do not represent additional predictions.
evidence.log_semantics: Retrospective scientific summaries of the retained completed execution; no reconstructed timestamps.
evidence.public_documentation: Methods and logs summarize the final saved scientific execution. Signed download query strings and superseded operational/layout copies are omitted.
